ambiguity_capacity: Common to every entry rule: cash remains unknown, but with continuously observed quotes release capacity no earlier than the latest mandatory holding expiry across possible branches. Pending branches use bucket 12+60-1; open branches use their observed entry bucket+60-1. Source gaps or insufficient future observations keep occupancy unresolved.
entry_state_equivalence: For alternative entries, merge equal execution states when their MFE values differ but the fixed 0.5R no-follow threshold flags agree. Store peak as a lower bound and peak_upper as the upper bound. Different threshold flags or fills remain unknown. Raw original breakout labels stay byte-equivalent to frozen controls.

rules.breakout: Original warning high/low plus tick, market on breakout; unchanged control.
rules.close_confirm: First subsequent completed 1m close reaches original trigger; enter at next observed minute open. Stop invalidation remains active before confirmation and entry. Original pending expiry is not renewed.
rules.retest25: Original breakout arms market-on-touch at trigger minus 25% of original trigger-to-structural-stop distance, rounded away from trigger to ticks. Intraminute sequence uncertainty remains unknown. An opening gap already past structural stop cancels the pending order.
rules.risk: Same warning-known original breakout plan must pass 500 yuan including forecast costs. Stops unchanged; gaps are never clipped. Entry changes do not rescue warning-ineligible plans.
rules.targets: cash200 is calculated using observable entry base and fixed 1tick forecast cost; stress uses same target. S1 uses original fixed structural target.
rules.capacity: One pending order or position per product from original warning, carry from all warmup snapshots. Every entry rule has its own continuous book.
rules.inference: Fixed six strategies, no threshold fitting. Joint-date 5/10 day blocks and separate BH families for six versus-zero and four same-target versus-breakout comparisons. Previously-inspected history remains development only.
